adjudication_note: Adversarial review round 3, gap S2. `ativo em taxa de juros` / `PASSIVO EM DÓLAR` name which side of a swap receives and which pays — not an item of economic value and not an obligation. precision-amendment-01 demoted the FEMININE `ativa` citing this exact construction (`swap ATIVA em pós-fixada is a swap leg`) and the diagnosis was never propagated to the masculine forms, which are the high-frequency ones. Registering the leg is better than forbidding it: the construction is CGA exam content and the concept was simply missing. Bare `ativo em` is NOT a form — `ativo em função de` and `ativo em relação ao` are the noun plus a preposition, so only the collocations that carry an index or a currency are registered.

concepts.def: The side of a swap a counterparty holds: active means it receives that index, passive means it pays it.
